name: ILO Labour Statistics (ILOSTAT) MCP Server
description: ILO labour statistics (ILOSTAT) with full provenance: source URL, data vintage, retrieval timestamp, license and ILO citation on every response. Tools to search indicators, read indicator metadata and dimension codes, and fetch data; reference resources (query guide, key dataflows by topic, provenance contract) and workflow prompts (country profile, compare countries, indicator trend). Hosted on Cloudflare Workers (Streamable HTTP, no auth) or local stdio. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the ILO. MIT licensed.
author: Sidney da S. P. Bissoli

tools.name: ilo_search_indicators
tools.title: Search ILOSTAT indicators
tools.description: Search the ILOSTAT catalogue of ~1,200 indicator dataflows by keywords in the name or id (e.g. "unemployment rate sex age"). All terms must match (AND, case-insensitive), so start with 2–3 English words and drop terms if you get 0 results; results are ranked by ILO relevance weight, not by match count. Reading the id tells you the shape: suffix _RT = rate/ratio, _NB = number (usually thousands); dataflows whose second token starts with 2 (e.g. DF_UNE_2EAP_…) are ILO modelled estimates with full country/year coverage, the others are reported national data. Returns dataflow ids to use with ilo_get_data / ilo_get_indicator_metadata. Searches the local catalogue only — it does not return statistical values (use ilo_get_data), does not search dimension codes such as countries (use ilo_list_dimension_values) and does not cover non-ILO sources.

query.description: Keywords, matched against dataflow name and id (AND between terms)

provenance_mode.description: Provenance verbosity: 'concise' (default — source, url, vintage, retrieval date, citation, license) or 'detailed' (full canonical block with dataset, dimension key and notices)

tools.name: ilo_get_indicator_metadata
tools.title: Get ILOSTAT indicator metadata
tools.description: Structure of one ILOSTAT dataflow: dimensions (in SDMX key order), their codelists, the time dimension, the source's default selection and the data vintage (last update at the ILO). Use before ilo_get_data to know which filters exist. Does not return statistical values and does not list the codes themselves (use ilo_list_dimension_values).

provenance_mode.description: Provenance verbosity: 'concise' (default — source, url, vintage, retrieval date, citation, license) or 'detailed' (full canonical block with dataset, dimension key and notices)

tools.name: ilo_list_dimension_values
tools.title: List valid codes of a dimension
tools.description: Valid codes (id + label) of one dimension of an ILOSTAT dataflow — e.g. the country/area codes of REF_AREA (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 such as BRA, plus X-codes for aggregates such as X01 World) or the categories of SEX (SEX_T/SEX_M/SEX_F) and AGE. Use `search` to resolve a name to a code (e.g. search "Brazil") instead of paging through hundreds of codes; codelists are shared across dataflows, so a code found here is valid wherever the same codelist is used. Use to build correct ilo_get_data filters. Does not return statistical values, does not say which codes actually have data for a given dataflow, and is not applicable to the time dimension (filter it via start_period/end_period in ilo_get_data).

dataflow.description: Dataflow id the dimension belongs to

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on code id or label

provenance_mode.description: Provenance verbosity: 'concise' (default — source, url, vintage, retrieval date, citation, license) or 'detailed' (full canonical block with dataset, dimension key and notices)

tools.name: ilo_get_data
tools.title: Get ILOSTAT data
tools.description: Statistical observations from one ILOSTAT dataflow, filtered by dimension codes (filters, e.g. {"REF_AREA": ["BRA","ARG"], "SEX": "SEX_T"}) and period (start_period/end_period, e.g. "2015"/"2024"). REF_AREA is required, maximum 30 areas per call — for broad panels, split areas into batches and/or paginate by period. Unfiltered dimensions return all their categories. Does not aggregate, convert or otherwise transform values (raw ILOSTAT data only), and does not search indicators (use ilo_search_indicators).

filters.description: Dimension id → code or list of codes (from ilo_list_dimension_values). REF_AREA is required (up to 30 area codes).

last_n_observations.description: Alternative to periods: only the latest N observations per series

provenance_mode.description: Provenance verbosity: 'concise' (default — source, url, vintage, retrieval date, citation, license) or 'detailed' (full canonical block with dataset, dimension key and notices)

tools.name: search
tools.title: Deep Research Search
tools.description:
Searches the ILOSTAT labour statistics (≈1,200 SDMX dataflows: employment, unemployment, wages, working time, informality, SDG labour indicators) catalog and returns up to 10 matching documents as { id, title, url }, ordered by relevance (an empty list means nothing matched).

This tool exists for the OpenAI Deep Research contract: ChatGPT deep research, company knowledge and research workflows over the Responses API require exactly the tools `search` and `fetch`. Pass one of the returned ids to `fetch` to read the document.
For direct questions and for data (values, series, rankings) prefer the `ilo_*` tools, which return the actual data with provenance — this is a catalog index, not a data query.

Query: natural language or keywords, Portuguese or English; accents and case are ignored.

Behavior: read-only and idempotent — the catalog comes from the public source and is cached in memory.

query.description: Search terms, natural language or keywords (accents and case are ignored)

id.description: Unique identifier of the document on this server; what `fetch` takes

url.description: Canonical public URL of the document — ChatGPT's citation depends on it

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Deep Research Document
tools.description:
Returns the full document for an id obtained from `search`, as { id, title, text, url, metadata }: `text` is the readable content (Markdown) and `url` the canonical public page to cite.

Companion of `search` in the OpenAI Deep Research contract, over the ILOSTAT labour statistics (≈1,200 SDMX dataflows: employment, unemployment, wages, working time, informality, SDG labour indicators) catalog. Only ids returned by `search` are valid; an unknown id returns an error.
The `ilo_*` tools remain the tools for data queries.

Behavior: read-only and idempotent — a live GET against the public source when the document needs it.

id.description: Identifier of a document returned by `search`
Unique identifier of the document on this server; what `fetch` takes

text.description: Full readable content of the document (Markdown)

url.description: Canonical public URL of the document — ChatGPT's citation depends on it

metadata.description: Additional key/value pairs about the document (kind, source, period…)

resources.name: ilostat-guide
resources.title: ILOSTAT query guide
resources.description: How to query ILOSTAT with this server: tool workflow, stable code conventions (REF_AREA ISO3 and X-aggregates, SEX, AGE, FREQ, dataflow id suffixes), limits and reporting rules. Read once per session to save discovery calls.

resources.name: ilostat-key-dataflows
resources.title: Key ILOSTAT dataflows by topic
resources.description: Verified dataflow ids for the most common indicators (unemployment, employment, participation, wages, working time, informality, NEET, SDG 8, productivity) — usable directly in ilo_get_data without searching.

resources.name: ilostat-provenance
resources.title: Provenance and citation contract
resources.description: Meaning of every provenance field returned with the data (source_url, data_vintage, retrieved_at, notices, license, citation) and how to cite the ILO correctly.

prompts.name: ilo_country_labour_profile
prompts.title: Country labour-market profile
prompts.description: Step-by-step workflow that assembles a labour-market profile of one country from ILOSTAT (unemployment, participation, employment ratio, informality, NEET, earnings, hours) with ILO citations.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Brazil" or "BRA"

prompts.name: ilo_compare_countries
prompts.title: Compare countries on an indicator
prompts.description: Workflow that compares several countries (or regional aggregates) on one ILOSTAT indicator in a single data call, flagging modelled estimates versus reported data.

arguments.name: countries
arguments.description: Comma-separated country names or ISO3 codes, e.g. "BRA, ARG, CHL"

arguments.name: indicator
arguments.description: Indicator in plain words, e.g. "youth unemployment rate"

prompts.name: ilo_indicator_trend
prompts.title: Indicator trend for a country
prompts.description: Workflow that retrieves the time series of one ILOSTAT indicator for one country and describes the trend (first/last, peak/trough, breaks in series) with citations.

arguments.name: indicator
arguments.description: Indicator in plain words, e.g. "labour force participation rate"

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "India" or "IND"
